x.preset_saved: Saved. It is now in the preset list and can go in a donut.
x.watch_hint: New files are converted into a 'converted' subfolder.
x.trigger_hint: Hold {0} while dragging files, or press {0}+D. The donut opens at your cursor.
x.profile_presets: Turn presets on for this donut on the Presets page.
x.profile_hint_custom: This donut opens when every picked file has one of these extensions.
x.profile_hint_default: This donut opens for the shortcut, and for picked files that no profile matches. Up to 8 slices.
x.keep_tray: Keep running in the tray when closed
x.start_login: Start with Windows, so the donut is always ready
x.pdf.hint: Select pages (Ctrl/Shift for several), then move, rotate, duplicate or delete them. Save writes a new PDF next to the original.
x.pdf.title: Edit PDF
x.ann.title: Annotate
x.donut_full: The donut is full. Remove a slice to make room for another.
x.donut_add_hint: Switch a preset on below to add it. Click a slice, or its ✕, to remove it.
x.donut_click: Click a slice to remove it
x.engine_explain: An engine is a small expert inside Mochi. Each one knows how to handle certain kinds of files: pictures, video, PDFs and so on. When you convert a file, Mochi asks the best ready engine to do the job. Most engines are built in. The few extras can be installed with one click.
x.priority: If two engines can do the same job, the higher one wins.
x.select_first: Select files in Explorer, then press the shortcut. Or drop files here.
x.ai.connect_hint: Mochi's AI tools use the AI you connect here. Your key stays on this PC, encrypted for your Windows account.
x.ai.tools_hint: They appear in the toolbar under “AI” (Summarise and Ask are pinned for you). Press the shortcut with files selected, then pick one.
x.ai.tools_list:
✦  Summarise: key points, dates and amounts of a PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint or text file
✦  Ask this file: type a question, get an answer from the file
✦  Explain image: describe a picture, read its text, tables and charts
✦  Smart rename: give messy files clear names, with preview and undo
✦  Do it by typing: say what you want (“compress these and zip them”) and Mochi chains the tools
x.th.looks_hint: One tap changes the whole app. Each look brings its own accent, which you can change below.
x.th.mode_fixed: This look is one fixed style. Pick Mochi to choose System, Light, Dark or Auto.
x.th.living_hint: The accent colour drifts slowly through the rainbow.
x.th.tint: Colour the backgrounds with the accent
x.th.oled_hint: True black background in dark looks (saves battery on OLED screens).
x.th.glass_hint: Mica and Acrylic let your wallpaper shine through the window (Windows 11).
x.th.sound_hint: A soft chime when a conversion finishes.
x.th.share_hint: Copy a short code, send it to a friend, and they get exactly your colours, spacing and font.
x.drop_on_slice: Drop the files on one of the slices, not on the middle.
x.no_files: That drag did not carry files Mochi can read (it carried: {0}). Save the file to a folder first, then drag it from there.
x.donut_note: Heads up: {0} files have their own donut, so “{1}” won't show for them yet.
x.donut_note_add: Also add it to the {0} donut
x.donut_profile_full: The {0} donut is full. Remove a slice here first, then add the new one.
x.sf.intro: Two helpers for the files already on your computer. Both run offline, nothing is uploaded.
x.sf.search_text: Type what you remember, like “invoice from March” or “trip to Goa”, and find the file even if you forgot its name. It reads inside PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and text files.
x.sf.tidy_text: Downloads full of random files? Mochi shows a plan first: pictures here, PDFs there, documents grouped by topic. Nothing is deleted, and you can undo it.
x.sf.folders_text: Mochi reads these folders quietly in the background, so a search never has to wait. Add the places where your documents live. Avoid whole drives.
x.toolbar_style_hint: Pick how the toolbar looks when you press the shortcut or drag files. All styles follow your theme, only offer tools that fit your files, and let you drop files on a tool.
x.qp.nofiles_hint: Drop files on a tool, or click a tool to choose files. Tip: select files in Explorer, then press the shortcut.
x.style_dock: Dock: one row of big icons
x.style_command: Command Bar: type what you want, press Enter
x.style_pad: Tile Pad: big colourful tiles with tabs
x.cb.search: What do you want to do? enhance, compress, to pdf…
x.bg.title: Remove background
x.bg.contig: Only the background touching the edges
x.bg.bgcolour: Background colour (use Pick colour to change)
x.bg.hint: Wheel zooms · middle mouse pans · Shift+click with Wand restores · [ and ] resize the brush · Ctrl+Z undoes
x.bg.ai_failed: The AI model could not run here, so the colour method is on:
x.persp.title: Perspective crop
x.persp.hint: Drag the four corners onto the corners of the page or sign, then press Crop.
x.model.title: Translation model (Ollama)
x.model.tip: Bigger models translate better. llama3.2 is the recommended one.
x.about_based: Mochi is built from Filee (MIT licence). Its UI strings and What's New slides belong to the Filee authors.
x.clip.title: Cut a clip
x.wm.title: Watermark
x.rg.title: Pages to keep
x.flip_hint: Flip the open donut with Tab, Space or the mouse wheel.
x.groups_hint: A group is one donut slice for several presets: rest on it and they fan out around it.
x.open_when_done: Open the folder when a conversion finishes
x.ctx_menu: Add “Convert with Mochi” to Explorer's right-click menu
x.size_hint: Ctrl + mouse wheel, Ctrl + plus/minus do the same; Ctrl 0 goes back to 100%.
x.up.title: Mochi update
x.up.installing: Installing. Mochi restarts by itself when it is done.
